decision.explanation: Three distinct entities share the acronym LCLS: the Lake County Public Library System in Florida is cited as having 15 libraries in one document and 3 in another (conflicting claims for the same referent), while the Luzerne County Library System in Pennsylvania is consistently described as administering 10 libraries.
